rules: Written for a human to read first.
Row 1: a short plain note. Row 2: headers. Both frozen.
Editable columns shaded; set column widths; filter on the data tab.
Dates like 28 Sep 2026. No record-ID codes, no 'source rows', no backup tabs, no private file paths.
Unknown values stay blank or 'Not recorded'.
